title: for y since
short: I've had this phone for two years / since 2024. for + tiempo que dura; since + momento en que empezó.

story.title: ¿Desde cuándo?
story.text: Para algo que ==empezó en el pasado y sigue ahora==, el inglés usa el present perfect con ==for== o ==since==.

examples.t: I've had this mobile for three years.
examples.es: Tengo este móvil desde hace tres años.

story.title: for = durante / desde hace
story.text: ==for== + una cantidad de tiempo: for ten minutes, for two weeks, for years, ==for ages== (desde hace siglos).

story.title: since = desde
story.text: ==since== + el momento en que empezó: since Monday, since 2010, since Christmas, since I retired.

examples.t: My son has worked there since May.
examples.es: Mi hijo trabaja allí desde mayo.

examples.t: I've known her since we were children.
examples.es: La conozco desde que éramos niñas.

story.title: En español, presente; en inglés, perfecto
story.text: Decimos «==vivo== aquí desde hace diez años» o «hace diez años que vivo aquí». En inglés no vale el presente: ==I've lived== here for ten years.

examples.t: I've known Emma for a year.
examples.es: Conozco a Emma desde hace un año.

examples.t: How long have you had your tablet?

story.title: for, since y ago
story.text: ==ago== (hace) es para algo ==terminado==, con pasado simple. for y since, para algo que ==sigue==.

examples.t: I bought it two years ago.
I've had it for two years.
examples.es: Lo tengo desde hace dos años.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ since three years ✅ ==for== three years
❌ I have this phone for two years. ✅ I ==have had== this phone for two years.
❌ I live here since 2010. ✅ I=='ve lived== here since 2010.

story.title: Truco: la pregunta
story.text: Para preguntar «¿desde cuándo…?» o «¿cuánto tiempo llevas…?»: ==How long have you…?== How long have you lived in your town?

compare.es: En español usamos el presente para algo que empezó antes y sigue: «Tengo este móvil desde hace dos años», «Hace dos años que lo tengo», «Llevo dos años con él». «Desde» sirve tanto para un periodo como para un momento.
compare.target: En inglés hace falta el present perfect: I've had this phone for two years. Además hay dos palabras: for + periodo (for two years) y since + punto de inicio (since 2024). Para preguntar: How long have you had it?

errors.wrong: I've had this phone since three years.
errors.right: I've had this phone for three years.
errors.why: Three years es una cantidad de tiempo: for.

errors.wrong: I have this phone for two years.
errors.right: I've had this phone for two years.
errors.why: Si empezó antes y sigue ahora, present perfect, no presente.
Con since + momento pasado, present perfect.
2015 es el momento en que empezó: since.

errors.wrong: How long do you know Emma?
errors.right: How long have you known Emma?
errors.why: ¿Desde cuándo…? = How long have you + participio?

errors.wrong: I've bought it two years ago.
errors.right: I bought it two years ago.
errors.why: Ago marca un momento terminado: pasado simple.

exercises.q: I've had this phone ___ three years.
exercises.why: Three years es una cantidad de tiempo: for.

exercises.q: We've lived in this flat ___ 1998.
exercises.why: 1998 es el momento en que empezó: since.

exercises.q: I've waited for the bus ___ twenty minutes!
exercises.why: Veinte minutos es duración: for.

exercises.q: She hasn't called me ___ Monday.
exercises.why: Monday es un momento de inicio: since.

exercises.q: I ___ Emma for two years.
exercises.why: Empezó antes y sigue: present perfect (have known).

exercises.q: I bought this tablet two years ___.
exercises.why: Compra terminada en el pasado: two years ago.

exercises.q: How long ___ you had your laptop?
exercises.why: ¿Desde cuándo tienes…? = How long have you had…?

exercises.q: My friend has used Instagram ___ 2020.
exercises.why: Un año concreto de inicio: since.

exercises.q: We haven't seen our grandchildren ___ a month.
exercises.es: No vemos a los nietos desde hace un mes.
exercises.why: Un mes es duración: for.

exercises.q: I haven't had a holiday ___ the summer.
exercises.es: No me he cogido vacaciones desde el verano.
exercises.why: El verano es el punto de inicio: since.

exercises.q: I've known my best friend ___ ages!
exercises.es: ¡Conozco a mi mejor amiga desde hace siglos!
exercises.why: For ages = desde hace muchísimo tiempo.

exercises.q: My friend has ___ in Madrid since September.
exercises.es: Mi amiga vive en Madrid desde septiembre.
exercises.why: Has + participio: lived.

exercises.q: How long have you ___ this number?
exercises.why: Have → had → had.

exercises.q: I ___ my neighbour since we were young.
exercises.why: Know → knew → known.

exercises.q: She ___ ill since Tuesday.
exercises.why: Be → was → been. Está mala desde el martes.

exercises.q: We ___ this car for ten years.
exercises.why: Have → had → had: we have had.

exercises.q: I've had this phone for two years.
answer: I have had this phone since 2024.
exercises.why: Dos años antes de 2026 es 2024: since 2024.

exercises.q: I live here since 2010.
exercises.why: Empezó y sigue: present perfect.

exercises.instr: Haz la pregunta con How long
exercises.q: She has worked at the bank for five years.
answer: How long has she worked at the bank?
exercises.why: How long + has + she + participio.

exercises.q: I've had this tablet since three years.
exercises.why: Three years es duración: for.

exercises.q: We've been friends for 2015.
exercises.why: 2015 es el punto de inicio: since.

exercises.q: I've known my neighbour since ages.
exercises.why: Ages es una cantidad de tiempo: for ages.

exercises.q: How long have you know Emma?
exercises.why: How long have you + participio: known.

exercises.es: Tengo esta tableta desde hace dos años
exercises.answer: I have had this tablet for two years
exercises.why: Have had + for + duración.

exercises.answer: We have lived in this village since 1985
exercises.why: Since + año de inicio.

exercises.answer: How long have you known Emma
exercises.why: How long have you known…?

exercises.q: Tengo este móvil desde hace tres años.
answer: I've had this mobile for three years.
I have had this mobile for three years.
I've had this phone for three years.
I have had this phone for three years.
I've had this mobile phone for three years.
exercises.why: Present perfect + for + duración.

exercises.q: No he visto a mi hijo desde Navidad.
answer: I haven't seen my son since Christmas.
I have not seen my son since Christmas.
exercises.why: Since + Christmas (punto de inicio).

exercises.q: They've been married for forty years.
answer: Están casados desde hace cuarenta años.
Hace cuarenta años que están casados.
exercises.why: En español, presente o «llevar»; en inglés, present perfect.

exercises.context: En la tienda te preguntan cuánto tiempo hace que tienes el móvil. Lo compraste hace cinco años y sigue funcionando.
options: I've had it for five years.
I have it since five years.
I had it for five years ago.
exercises.answer: I've had it for five years.
exercises.why: Sigue siendo tuyo: I've had it for five years.

exercises.context: Quieres preguntarle a tu amiga inglesa desde cuándo vive en España.
options: How long have you lived in Spain?
How long do you live in Spain?
Since when you live in Spain?
exercises.answer: How long have you lived in Spain?
exercises.why: ¿Desde cuándo…? = How long have you + participio?
for + duración; since + inicio; ago + pasado terminado.
